title:
An "invocation" represents a simple function call to a known method. This is the best form when the function name
and arguments are known at code-generation time.

For example:
```java
Jsn.parse(s)
```
Here the method is known as well as the expression that makes up the only argument.

This also supports python keyword arguments:
```py
c3.Jsn.parse(json=s)
```

@see Code.Apply
@see Code.Call
@see Code.New
